body:
## Summary
- harden the Android/macOS file-transfer product E2E evidence gate so no-Host UI, summary-only, synthetic, missing source/destination bytes, mismatched device identity, and weak artifact records cannot close it
- require child bulk and Phase 0 aggregate gates to validate file-transfer safety/closure flags and re-check the formal report's referenced product evidence
- document the retained evidence contract, accepted Android device identities, and why these checks remain fail-closed until Host-backed bidirectional product evidence exists

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_gate tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest discover tools/tests
- python3 -m py_compile tools/vibescreen_evidence/file_transfer_android_smoke.py tools/vibescreen_evidence/phase0_stable_release.py tools/vibescreen_evidence/file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest.py tools/vibescreen_evidence/file_transfer_bulk_current_base_gate.py
- make file-transfer-bulk-current-base-gate EVIDENCE_DIR=.build/evidence/file-transfer-bulk-current-base
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- git diff --check

## Notes
- Did not run Vibe Screen/MacHost GUI, swift run, adb reverse, or TCC/System Settings changes.
- The bulk current-base gate still reports blocked for missing real child product evidence, as expected for fail-closed behavior.
title: Harden file-transfer product E2E evidence gates
